author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Midnight Deadline
challenge.description: The nightly data job is failing to finish before the store managers open the ordering app. #reliability_ruth# demands an automated validation layer to catch bad data instantly so the morning window is never missed again. #data_dave# insists on keeping the process manual for now, arguing that the infrastructure costs are too high and the current manual checks are sufficient to manage the risk.

output.content: I am not ready to sign off on the automated validation layer yet. The infrastructure costs for a fully automated check at this scale are too high for our current budget. I am willing to accept keeping the ingestion step manual for the time being. The manual checks we run today are sufficient to manage the risk of bad data entering the system. If we can save the money on the infrastructure, I am happy to stick with the manual process. I do not want to spend that capital on automation while the current setup still holds.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept keeping the ingestion step manual and forgo the benefits of automation to save on infrastructure costs, indicating a conscious acceptance of a loss in exchange for budget preservation.
